SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM time_dim WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30) AS filtered_time ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = filtered_time.t_time_sk

WHERE store.s_store_name = 'ese' 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) 
LIMIT 100
